featured_reviews.name: Lo Loneo3006
featured_reviews.review_text:
Simran and Aman are running this rescue centre exceptionally.
They are fantastic with the animals, and take care of even the most critical cases. Not only they rescue, dogs, cats, birds...but also, they feed stray dogs (around 300 every night).

I am a french volunteer, I spent two days with them and really wished I could have stayed longer. They hosted me, fed me, welcome me into their home as if I was family. If you have the chance to be in Mumbai, go visit them, spent time their, participate and if you can donate/adopt to support their continuing effort to make Mumbai a better place for dogs and cats.

@Simran, next time I am in Mumbai, count on me to spend more time with your shelter.

featured_reviews.name: Niteesha Tolani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Salute to the Walia family for sheltering over 120 handicapped stray dogs and many cats. Over and above they step out every evening to feed 350 strays in their neighbourhood. Selflessly and fearless they have given their lives to revive and shelter and take care of these innocent animals. Each dog has a story. Some with broken legs, lost eyes, infested fur coats, neurological disorders and more. It’s not easy to do what the Walias do. Day and Night 365 days.
All and any support would benefit the Anil and and support the family in their wonderful work. Even a visit would the family and dogs so happy.
After all we are all creatures made up of love ❤️

name: Project Vaani Animal Rescue ( Not an NGO )
description: Founded in Nalasopara East, Project Vaani Animal Rescue is dedicated to providing compassionate care for local animals in need. Opening its doors in late 2016, this animal rescue service focuses on the well-being and safety of every creature it assists. With a commitment to the Vasai-Virar community, Project Vaani strives to create a nurturing environment and a second chance for every animal. Located near Agarwal Residency, its mission is to protect and serve the beloved animals of the area.
